settings.heading: Build something with theINmag
settings.subhead: Brands, schools, festivals, fellow creators - if you've got an idea that celebrates kids, we'd love to chat. Even rough thoughts welcome.

settings.heading: Tell us what you're imagining
settings.intro_html: We're open to all kinds of partnerships - brand collabs, editorial features, events, school programs, anything that celebrates kids. Even a half-formed idea is plenty. We'd rather brainstorm together than make you write a pitch deck.
settings.success_body: Thanks for getting in touch - we read every message personally. If it feels like a good fit, we'll be back in your inbox within a week to start the brainstorm properly.
settings.social_text: Curious to see what theINmag is about? Find us on Instagram and Facebook.
